notes.title: Quizmaster Update
notes.notes:
After playing with friends added that you can still see the different options in Quizmaster while the answer is given. Making it that it is more usable for different activities where you will need your own questions. At the moment Quizmaster and Trivia have over 1000 questions and more to be added soon!

Other updates:
- Updated the question about Storm (Marvel character) to be correct. 
- Preparing for space game update
